The '''Internal Security Agency''', or '''ISA''', is an institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of [[Huanglong]]. Reporting directly to the [[Emperor of Huanglong]], it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing [[Resonator]]s.
